text.description: js code to execute. You can use 'ctx' inside code to call tools available, e.g. await ctx.exec("tool_name", { param: value }),  it is also possible to call LLM from code:   await ctx.file2run({ system: "You are helpful assistant" user: "user request: @data "  }, { data: "value of template variable") to proper escape user input file2run template engine instead of javascripts ${}. Remember that tool result of await ctx.exec("tool") is always string, if you expcect json, do json parse
